word.create_sql:
CREATE TABLE word (
					id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
					word TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
					phonetic TEXT,
					word_type TEXT,
					image TEXT
				)

word_meaning.create_sql:
CREATE TABLE word_meaning (
					id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
					word_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
					stage INTEGER,
					pos TEXT,
					meaning_en TEXT,
					meaning_zh TEXT,
					source TEXT,
					word_tag TEXT,
					FOREIGN KEY(word_id) REFERENCES word(id)
				)

word_form.create_sql:
CREATE TABLE word_form (
					id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
					word_id INTEGER,
					form_type TEXT,
					form TEXT,
					FOREIGN KEY(word_id) REFERENCES word(id)
				)

word_example.create_sql:
CREATE TABLE word_example (
					id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
					meaning_id INTEGER,
					example_en TEXT,
					example_zh TEXT,
					difficulty INTEGER,
					image TEXT,
					example_tag TEXT,
					audio_path TEXT,
					FOREIGN KEY(meaning_id) REFERENCES word_meaning(id)
				)
